title: pyppeteer-snap
subtitle: Website Screenshot Tool
description: The original Pyppeteer screenshot helper. Archived; new work uses playwright-snap with the same function names, arguments and return types.
longDescription: A Python helper returning website PNG and PDF snapshots as base64. The project is archived because its Pyppeteer browser dependency is no longer maintained. Its successor, playwright-snap, keeps the same API with Playwright-driven Chromium.
features: PNG and PDF snapshots as base64
